en: A vintage black-and-white image showing two large, elegant houses in a residential area with a tree-lined background. The architecture is distinctly European, with timber framing and ornate rooflines. The street in front is labeled, and the overall style suggests early 20th century. The words 'Hirschberg' (top right) and 'Moltketstrasse II' (bottom center) are visible.
